disputed.finding: The draft treats the 'first stocktake in 2023' as a future schedule. Today is Nov 2026, so the first stocktake concluded at COP28 (Dec 2023) and the second is due in 2028. Parties' 2025 NDC 3.0 round followed. The draft is dated and omits this.
disputed.objection: The notes do not establish the later post-2023 schedule or the date-sensitive status described here, so this is an external-temporal criticism rather than something settled by the notes.

disputed.finding: The draft says Article 4(11) gives flexibility to change an NDC 'before the next formal five-year cycle.' The notes only say a Party may adjust at any time to enhance ambition; they do not frame this as specifically before the next cycle.
disputed.objection: Adjusting 'at any time' necessarily includes adjusting before the next five-year cycle, so the draft's phrase is a trivial implication of the quoted text and not a meaningful overreach.
